annotations.title: Send a Nod to its personal page or a meeting

description: to "page" opens the Nod's personal page to visitors (after an automatic leak check) and returns its URL and the embed code; pass embed_origins to let other websites show it. to "meeting" with meeting_url (Zoom, Teams, Meet or Webex) sends it into that call as a guest named with "(AI agent)" that says it is an AI, listens and speaks only (no tools), one meeting at a time, at the outside-meeting price; the host may have to let it in. to "meetingburner_room" with meeting_url (a MeetingBurner room link) sends it into the room as a member with its face and voice, on your own MeetingBurner outside agent key: send it once as meetingburner_key and it is kept. You must be in the room first, and MeetingBurner allows one of your agents on camera at a time. stop_session with the returned session_id brings it home. Needs a verified owner.

audience.description: Who may talk to the page: "public" (anyone, the default) or "invited".

embed_origins.description: Websites that may show the embed, e.g. ["https://example.com"]. Left out keeps the current list.

meetingburner_key.description: Your MeetingBurner outside agent key. Needed once; it is kept in a vault and never shown again.

name: send_nod

embed_code.description: The one line a website pastes to show this Nod.

probe.description: The red-team check that runs before a page opens. A failed check keeps the page closed.

send_id.description: Null when the page stayed closed (status blocked).

session_id.description: For a meeting or a MeetingBurner room: read or stop it with get_session or stop_session.

title: Send a Nod to its personal page or a meeting
